items.title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
items.summary: The crash, between a moving train and another that was stopped further up the track, was caused by an "inexplicable" error, the transport minister said.

items.title: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
items.summary: Survivors of the train crash in Spain have spoken of their shock, panic and anger at the accident in Toledo province on Wednesday.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
items.summary: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.

items.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
items.summary: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

items.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
items.summary: With 85% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.

items.title: Girl seriously injured in wolf attack at German wildlife park
items.summary: The eight-year-old was in an enclosure with other children and a staff member when she was attacked.
